en: <t1/> measures the Rust executable's coverage once — one instrumented export, test code excluded from both the covered and the total so a test added never flatters the number — and reports line, function and region coverage by one rule. Three gates read that one judgment. The crate floor (<t2/>) is a lower bound on the whole executable. The session/continuity domain (<t3/>) is held to a floor of its own on lines, functions and regions. Both floors are ratchets: each is the coverage its subject measured when it was set, and may rise and never fall. And the differential gate (<t4/>, rule <t5/>) holds every executable line, function and region a change adds or touches — measured against the branch's merge-base with the trunk, working tree included — so a change that introduces uncovered code is refused even while the aggregate percentage barely moves.

en: Every server restart is a new stream of the journal, so runtimes compact away streams that have been dead for long. Compaction takes away the records of those streams and nothing anyone still relies on: a claim that holds and a session that is open are never touched; a handover nobody has taken keeps its stream for a day past the retention, and no longer, so a machine whose runs each handed over something cannot fill its quota with the dead; a handover still offered keeps everyone who took it, and a review keeps every answer, even when the taker's or the answerer's runtime has stopped. And a runtime compacted away while it slept — a laptop past the expiry and the fifteen-minute retention — is heard again when it wakes: its peers fetch its stream again from the first event, so a claim it took before it slept holds again there and refuses a conflicting one.
cs: Každý restart serveru je nový stream žurnálu, takže runtime kompaktují streamy, které jsou dlouho mrtvé. Compaction odebírá záznamy těchto streamů a nic, na co se ještě někdo spoléhá: platný nárok a otevřená relace se nikdy nedotknou; předávka, kterou nikdo nevzal, drží svůj stream den po retenci a ne déle, takže stroj, jehož každý běh něco předal, nemůže zaplnit kvótu mrtvými; stále nabízená předávka drží každého, kdo ji vzal, a revize drží každou odpověď, i když runtime toho, kdo vzal nebo odpověděl, přestal běžet. A runtime zkompaktovaný, zatímco spal — notebook po expiraci a patnáctiminutové retenci — je opět slyšet, když se probudí: jeho peery znovu stáhnou jeho stream od první události, takže nárok, který převzal před spánkem, tam opět platí a odmítne konfliktní.
